nodes.description: Constructor that stores the logic contract address in a fixed storage slot, delegatecalls the supplied constructData, emits the returned bytes, and requires success.
Payable external fallback that loads the logic address from the fixed storage slot and delegatecalls all calldata to it, copying calldata/returndata manually.
Storage slot keccak256('PROXIABLE') = 0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7 holding the implementation/logic contract address.
Inline assembly sstore writing contractLogic into the PROXIABLE storage slot, bypassing Solidity storage layout guarantees.
delegatecall(constructData) executed by the logic contract inside the constructor context, returning (success, __) and executing arbitrary logic with the proxy's storage.
Inline assembly delegatecall(gas(), contractLogic, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) forwarding arbitrary calldata to the stored logic address and bubbling up returndata.
Raw calldatacopy/returndatacopy and switch-based revert/return handling performed in inline assembly without input validation.
bytes memory constructData: arbitrary initialization calldata forwarded to the logic contract via delegatecall.
address contractLogic: implementation address controlled at deployment, stored in the PROXIABLE slot and used as delegatecall target.
bool success: result flag of the constructor delegatecall, checked by require to revert construction on failure.
bytes memory __: returndata of the constructor delegatecall, emitted through myEvent.

edges.reason: constructData is passed straight into delegatecall as the calldata payload, letting deployment-time bytes drive arbitrary code execution in the proxy's context.
contractLogic parameter is the value written by the sstore assembly instruction into the PROXIABLE storage slot.
contractLogic is the address whose code is executed by delegatecall in the constructor.
The assembly sstore writes the logic address into the fixed state variable slot.
The delegatecall returns the boolean success flag assigned to the local variable success.
The delegatecall returns the raw __ bytes that are captured and emitted in myEvent.
require(success) inside the constructor reverts deployment when the delegatecall failed, so the local flag controls constructor execution flow.
The fallback sloads the PROXIABLE slot and uses the retrieved address as the delegatecall target.
The sloaded logic address is part of the assembly block that also performs calldatacopy/returndatacopy handling.
The raw calldata copied to memory 0x0 is consumed by the delegatecall as its input and the returndata buffers handle its output.
The constructor invokes the delegatecall, so the deployment transaction controls whether arbitrary logic executes.
The fallback function body unconditionally forwards execution to the delegatecall, making every unknown call reach the logic contract.
The fallback executes the inline assembly block containing the calldata/returndata copy and success switch logic.

normalization_plan.reason: constructData is a non-core parameter consumed only as the calldata argument of the constructor delegatecall, so it should be absorbed into that unsafe_operation.
contractLogic is a non-core parameter whose only role is to be stored and used as the delegatecall target, so it should be merged into the constructor delegatecall.
success is a non-core local variable produced directly by the constructor delegatecall and used only for its require check, so it should be merged into that unsafe_operation.
__ is a non-core local variable holding the delegatecall returndata and exists only as that call's output, so it should be merged into the same unsafe_operation.
